addition.item: Added Joomla article-backed answers using the fast bounded DevArt article picker
Added editable answer titles and intro text populated automatically from selected Joomla articles
Added answer intro text with a maximum length of 300 characters without copying the article full text
Added article intro image support with the full article image as fallback
Added compact image previews for manual and article-backed answers
Added drag-and-drop and accessible up/down answer ordering controls
Added configurable same-window and new-window article link targets

change.item: Refined the Questions interface with numbered answer cards and clearer field grouping
Separated answer ordering controls from the destructive remove action
Preserved the selected article title and ID after saving and reloading a poll
Limited article links to answer titles while keeping images and intro text unlinked
Replaced custom Media Manager iframe markup with Joomla Dialog and Media APIs
Kept article selection bounded and count-free for fast operation on very large Joomla content tables
Preserved existing option IDs and their associated votes when answers are reordered
Improved JED Checker compatibility by removing encoding and JAMSS false-positive patterns

security.item: Article selections are validated server-side before saving
Frontend article resolution respects Joomla publication, access and language rules
Vote return URLs use bounded plain transport with strict same-site validation
Request rate limiting remains active for vote, token, refresh, proof-of-work and email OTP endpoints
Answer intro text is stored and rendered as escaped plain text

Added safe wrapping for long names, translations and increased font sizes
Made answer images responsive without causing horizontal overflow
Kept result progress bars at the full available container width

note.item: Responsive frontend maintenance update for Joomla 6
Applies to poll results rendered through both the component and the site module

Install or update using the full pkg_devartpolls package only
Safe update from DevArt Polls 1.1.1
No database migration or configuration changes are required

addition.item: Added optional verified email voting without Joomla registration or login
Added delivery of a short-lived 6-digit verification code through the Joomla mail configuration
Added one-vote-per-poll enforcement for each verified email using a keyed poll-specific hash
Added OTP expiry, limited verification attempts, resend cooldown and per-email and per-IP request limits
Added support for Joomla Proof of Work, reCAPTCHA v2 and Cloudflare Turnstile before OTP delivery

change.item: Simplified verified email voting to one clear email plus code mode
Removed the combined verified email plus cookie plus IP voting mode
Automatically converts legacy email_cookie_ip settings to verified email mode
Clears obsolete response cookie and IP hashes from verified-email votes without removing votes
Preserved all existing anonymous duplicate-protection modes and cache-safe voting flows
Preserved existing polls, surveys, modules, votes, results and configuration during updates

security.item: Plaintext voter email addresses are not stored
Email identities are stored as keyed poll-specific hashes
Verification codes are securely hashed at rest and can be used only once
IP hashes are used only for short-lived OTP request rate limiting and never as voter identities
Cookie and IP identity checks are not combined with verified email voting
Configured bot protection is validated before sending a verification email

note.item: Important voting and privacy update for Joomla 6
One verified email address equals one vote per poll or survey
Verified email voting does not guarantee one physical person per vote because multiple or disposable email addresses may exist
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3+
Requires correctly configured Joomla outbound mail for verified email voting
Install or update using the full pkg_devartpolls package only
Safe update from DevArt Polls 1.0.0
Validated and successfully tested on Joomla

Added Poll mode for one anonymous question with aggregate counters
Added Survey mode for multiple questions, stored responses, response manager and CSV export
Added single choice and multiple choice question types

Added optional bot protection with Joomla Proof of Work, reCAPTCHA v2 and Cloudflare Turnstile

Added survey JSON import and export with size, type and structure limits
Added result charts, themes, sizes and optional answer images

Added repository README, CHANGELOG, release QA gate and CLI smoke tests

change.item: Voting architecture designed for Joomla 6, PHP 8.3+ and Full Page Cache / Cloudflare compatibility
Maintained poll and question responses_count counters avoid page-view COUNT scans on response tables
Duplicate protection enforces UNIQUE (poll_id, visitor_hash) with duplicate-key handling

Survey wizard hides inactive steps on first paint to prevent refresh flash of all questions
Administrator list ordering uses an allow-list for filter_order values
CSV export sanitizes formula-like cell prefixes before download
Vote JSON responses use Cache-Control no-store without Vary Cookie
Runtime schema migration ensures legacy responses_count columns exist before SELECT

security.item: Added trusted proxy validation before accepting CF-Connecting-IP or X-Forwarded-For

Added CSRF token checks on administrator mutating and export actions
Added ACL enforcement for administrator manage, create, edit and delete actions
Added JSON import caps for file size, decode depth, question count and options per question
Added controller to service to storage flow without exposing filesystem paths in frontend responses
